comments: Independent indie project. Automated checks run via axe-core in a headless Chromium; violations are mapped to WCAG success criteria and weighted into a 0-100 score. Free tier: 5 scans/day, no signup.
features: Free online accessibility checker. Scans any public web page in a real browser with axe-core, maps violations to WCAG 2.2 success criteria and returns a 0-100 health score with prioritized fixes. No signup required; up to 5 free scans per day.
title: A11yMonitor
